prompt_text:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production raster terrain tile source for HARVEST THE NIGHT, a cozy farm that becomes a fortress against zombies at night.
Input images: Image 1 is the native-approved grass base source, a material identity and boundary-color reference only. Image 2 is the approved neutral-day style study, a visual reference only. Do not copy buildings, actors or dense ground texture. Neither image is an edit target.
Style/medium: hand-crafted low-contrast pixel art with deliberate flat pixel clusters, restrained texture and readable materials. Render as a clearly visible coarse 16 by 16 pixel lattice enlarged to fill the whole square source; no fine subpixel detail.
Composition/framing: ONE fully opaque square material tile filling the image edge to edge, direct top-down surface on a rectangular grid. Final native output is exactly 16x16, contact pivot (8,16); this is a downstream reduction target. No diamond/isometric block or tile shown in perspective. No contact shadow.
Lighting/mood: neutral daytime, very subtle upper-left material highlights; runtime supplies dusk/night lighting.
Constraints: opposite edges join seamlessly when repeated, no frame, border, vignette, central emblem, labels, text, watermark or UI. Calm open areas, no random speckles, dots, flowers, objects, cast shadows, blur, gradients, smooth painting or 3D render. All texture must survive nearest reduction to 16x16.
Primary request: ONE different quiet grass variant, terrain/grass_c. Match the grass master's dominant #6A9646 olive lawn and exactly its outer-edge color. At least 91% calm base green, including the entire outermost 1/16 on all four sides. Use just ONE small softly grouped asymmetric joined grass-blade cluster a little left/below the center, with sparse #4E7A35 shadow and one or two coarse #8AB659 highlight pixels. Keep the whole cluster under six downstream 16x16 pixel cells total; no tall grass object or strongly outlined tuft. This variation must be plainly different from the reference's three-cluster layout, but have the same quiet material brightness and seamless boundaries. No dots everywhere, flowers, stones, soil, frame or perimeter line.
decision: Accepted after native/3x repeated patches, exact borders, raw alpha and day/dusk/night Godot actor/farm review.
